incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: HIGH severity — node-gpu-7a3 lost heartbeat. Auto-page triggered (PD#12345). Notifying oncall.

tilly: ack. I'm on it.

pagerduty: Automated escalation: paging SRE primary -> secondary.

tilly: quick peek at serial console — seeing a kernel oops right before the heartbeat drop. attaching excerpt:```
[ 1234.567890] BUG: unable to handle kernel NULL pointer dereference at ffff800012345678
[ 1234.567895] CPU: 1 PID: 0 Comm: swapper/1 Not tainted 5.10.0-rc1
[ 1234.567900] Hardware name: Acme/GPU-Server-1
[ 1234.567905] Call Trace:
  dump_stack+0x6d/0x90
  panic+0x101/0x25c
  ? nvme_error_handler+0x40/0x40
Kernel panic - not syncing: Fatal exception
```

alex: @tilly can you confirm kubelet/node status? run: `kubectl get nodes node-gpu-7a3 -o wide`

tilly: ran it, output:```
NAME           STATUS     ROLES   AGE   VERSION
node-gpu-7a3   NotReady   <none>  12d   v1.26.3
```
kubelet systemd journal shows repeated failures: `kubelet.service: Main process exited, code=exited, status=1/FAILURE`

marta: can you reach the BMC/IPMI? trying `ipmitool -I lanplus -H 10.8.44.23 -U admin -P **** chassis power status` — I'm getting `Error: Unable to establish IPMI v2 / RMCP+ session`

incident-bot: Automated pre-checks: pods on node-gpu-7a3 — 3 pods evicted, 12 rescheduled to other nodes in pool 'dedicated-gpu'. No automatic rollback triggered.

leo: quick routing note — traffic for tenant ai-shop briefly fell back to burst-pool for ~90s while reschedule happened. Some realtime model requests returned 503s, looks like ~30 requests across 2 tenants. Low customer impact but worth tracking.

tilly: cordoning/draining now: `kubectl cordon node-gpu-7a3` -> `node/node-gpu-7a3 cordoned`
`kubectl drain node-gpu-7a3 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` -> `evicting pods... done`

marta: drain completed. syslog shows NVME resets a few seconds before panic:```
Mar 21 11:02:10 kernel: nvme0: controller error, resetting
Mar 21 11:02:10 kernel: nvme0: I/O 0 QID 0 timeout, aborted
Mar 21 11:02:11 kernel: nvme0: queue dead, aborting
Mar 21 11:02:13 kernel: kernel panic - not syncing: attempted to kill idle task
```

tilly: opening an RMA with colo now, requesting onsite tech for BMC/hard power cycle. If they can't reach BMC, we'll RMA drive/host.

alex: should we notify customers via status page? My recommendation: post a brief note indicating degraded throughput for a small subset of customers and that we're working on hardware RMA.

tilly: good call. I'll coordinate a status update after RMA is scheduled. handing off monitor+followup to @sre-lead — I'll stay on thread for 15m then hand over. Runbook: https://internal.runbooks/node-failures (see steps 1-5).

sre-lead: ack — taking over. Incident record created INC-2026-0421. I've tagged eng-runtime and support. I'll update every 15m or on any status change. Current action items: (1) confirm RMA ETA with colo (2) ensure rescheduled pods are healthy (3) validate any customer retries.

incident-bot: PD update: RMA scheduled by colo at 11:50 UTC (ETA ~47m). Node remains unreachable via BMC.

sre-lead: noted. marking this thread as active-handoff -> will ping here with next status update. :white_check_mark:
